services.intro: Every plan at Dolce Estetica starts with a surgeon's consultation and candidacy check, so you know if it suits your body before you decide.

items.name: Abdomen
items.text: Target the stubborn belly fat that diet and exercise have not moved, from the upper and lower abdomen to stubborn bands

items.name: Waist
items.text: Reshape love handles and flanks with ultrasound precision, for a more defined torso

items.name: Arms
items.text: Selective fat removal for the upper arms, planned to preserve nerves and connective tissue

items.name: Thighs
items.text: Inner and outer thigh contouring, planned to keep your proportions natural and balanced

items.name: Back

items.name: Body Contouring

results.heading: Real Results, Zero Filters
results.text: VASER reshapes your contour. It is not weight loss, and keeping the result depends on a stable, healthy lifestyle. Swelling hides the final shape for weeks, and definition appears gradually over months. Outcomes vary from person to person

faqs.q: Am I a candidate for VASER liposuction?
faqs.a: Usually, people close to a stable weight, in good health, and bothered by specific areas of stubborn fat. It is not a weight-loss treatment and it is not right for everyone. The surgeon's consultation exists to answer this honestly for your body and your health

faqs.q: How is VASER different from regular liposuction?
faqs.a: VASER uses ultrasound energy to loosen fat cells before removal, which allows finer, more selective contouring. It is designed to spare nerves, vessels, and connective tissue, and recovery is typically more comfortable than conventional liposuction

Many patients are up and walking within a day or two and back to desk work within about a week, with compression garments worn for several weeks as advised. Swelling settles gradually and the final contour emerges over months. Your surgeon maps your timeline before surgery

faqs.q: How much does VASER liposuction cost?
faqs.a: It depends on the number and size of areas treated, anaesthesia, and theatre time. After your consultation, you get one complete, itemised written quote covering the procedure, facility, anaesthesia, and aftercare, so nothing appears after you decide. EMI options are available

The fat cells removed from the treated areas do not return. The remaining cells can still grow if weight is gained, so results hold best with a stable, healthy lifestyle. We would rather you hear this now than after surgery

services.heading: A HydraFacial Matched to Your Skin Concern
services.intro: Every HydraFacial at Dolce Estetica starts with a doctor's skin assessment, then personalizes three steps according to your skin: cleanse and peel, extract and hydrate, protect and finish

items.name: Deep Cleansing
items.text: Clear out the build-up. Gentle exfoliation and vortex extraction loosen dead skin cells, unclog congested pores, and lift out impurities without irritation

items.name: Hydration
items.text: Give thirsty skin a drink. Antioxidant and hyaluronic serums are infused into freshly cleaned skin to restore moisture and a healthy glow

items.name: Acne
items.text: Calm breakout-prone skin. Targeted decongestion and salicylic infusions help with congestion and active inflammation, without harsh scrubbing

items.name: Pigmentation
items.text: Brighten uneven tone. Boosters and active serums chosen for your skin tone are layered on freshly exfoliated skin to help lighten dark spots

items.name: Skin Rejuvenation
items.text: Refresh dull, tired skin. Cellular renewal and nourishing peptides support smoother texture and a fresh, event-ready look
items.concern: Dull skin or want a glow

results.heading: Real Results, Zero Filters
results.text: Many of our clients notice fresher, brighter-looking skin right after a session, with no redness or downtime. Results build over a course and vary from person to person

concerns: Dull skin or want a glow

faqs.q: Is there any downtime after a HydraFacial?
faqs.a: No. Your skin may look slightly flushed for an hour or two, and most people go straight back to work or an event the same day. The only strict rule afterwards is sun protection

faqs.q: How often should I get a HydraFacial?
faqs.a: For maintenance, roughly once a month keeps skin looking fresh. For a specific concern like congestion or dullness, your doctor may suggest a short course first. The plan is set after your skin assessment, never sold as a default package

faqs.q: Can I get a HydraFacial if I have acne?
faqs.a: Often yes, because the deep-cleansing step helps congested skin. But active, inflamed acne changes what the session should include. That is why your doctor assesses your skin first, so the treatment helps your breakouts instead of irritating them

faqs.q: How much does a HydraFacial cost?
faqs.a: It depends on the version that suits your skin and whether you need a single session or a course. You get the full, itemised figure in writing at your consultation, before your first session

faqs.q: How is this different from a regular salon facial?
faqs.a: A salon facial mostly massages and freshens the surface. A HydraFacial extracts impurities from pores and infuses serums into cleaned skin, and it happens in a clinic where a doctor has assessed your skin first and can spot anything that needs medical treatment instead of a facial
